A JSON with color names and its values. Based on http://example.invalid/csswg/css-color/#named-colors.

[![NPM](https://example.invalid/npm/color-name.png?mini=true)](https://example.invalid/npm/color-name/)


```js
var colors = require('color-name');
colors.red //[255,0,0]
```
